title: Accounts, identity, and tenancy — quick overview
rememberThis: AWS account = hard isolation for IAM, billing, and quotas — split prod from non-prod at account level.
SCPs set org-wide maximum permissions; IAM grants within that ceiling — SCPs never grant.
Roles + STS for services; IAM Identity Center for humans; explicit Deny always wins.
Multi-tenant SaaS: silo vs pool tradeoff; enforce tenant_id in app, not just infrastructure.
Tags allocate cost and drive automation — they are not a security boundary.
bullets: Cross-account: AssumeRole with ExternalId and aws:SourceAccount conditions.
Debug AccessDenied: check SCP, then IAM, then resource policy.
Pooled SaaS: tenantId on every query, cache key, and S3 prefix; test IDOR.
Activate cost allocation tags; enforce Environment tag at create via SCP.
